listing.name: Rule of Rose — RoR-Port (RaikoDenpa)
listing.summary: This personal work in progress uses reverse engineering and static recompilation. It reaches the main program and draws the first frames. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SLES54218 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate code and build locally with Ghidra and your own disc. This guide does not establish a ready-to-run player package.
